mapper.select: SELECT id FROM alphafrog_agent_run WHERE id = #{runId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT detail FROM ( SELECT 'ACTIVE_NODE work_item=' || wi.id || ' run=' || wi.run_id || ' epoch=' || wi.claim_epoch AS detail FROM alphafrog_agent_run_work_item wi LEFT JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_tree_budget_operation o ON o.operation_id = 'active-node:' || wi.id || ':' || wi.claim_epoch WHERE wi.state IN ('CLAIMED', 'EXECUTING') AND (o.operation_id IS NULL OR o.kind != 'ACTIVE_NODE' OR o.state != 'CONFIRMED' OR o.root_run_id != COALESCE( (SELECT ci.root_run_id FROM alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent ci WHERE ci.child_run_id = wi.run_id), wi.run_id)) UNION ALL SELECT 'EXTERNAL_WAIT group=' || g.id || ' run=' || g.run_id AS detail FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g LEFT JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_tree_budget_operation o ON o.operation_id = 'external-wait:' || length(g.run_id) || ':' || g.run_id || ':' || g.plan_generation || ':' || length(g.node_id) || ':' || g.node_id || ':' || g.node_attempt || ':' || g.segment_sequence || ':' || g.model_turn WHERE g.state = 'WAITING' AND (o.operation_id IS NULL OR o.kind != 'EXTERNAL_WAIT' OR o.state != 'CONFIRMED' OR o.root_run_id != COALESCE( (SELECT ci.root_run_id FROM alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent ci WHERE ci.child_run_id = g.run_id), g.run_id)) UNION ALL SELECT 'ACTIVE_NODE orphan operation=' || o.operation_id AS detail FROM alphafrog_agent_run_tree_budget_operation o WHERE o.kind = 'ACTIVE_NODE' AND o.state != 'RELEASED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run_work_item wi WHERE wi.state IN ('CLAIMED', 'EXECUTING') AND o.operation_id = 'active-node:' || wi.id || ':' || wi.claim_epoch) UNION ALL SELECT 'EXTERNAL_WAIT orphan operation=' || o.operation_id AS detail FROM alphafrog_agent_run_tree_budget_operation o WHERE o.kind = 'EXTERNAL_WAIT' AND o.state != 'RELEASED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g WHERE g.state = 'WAITING' AND o.operation_id = 'external-wait:' || length(g.run_id) || ':' || g.run_id || ':' || g.plan_generation || ':' || length(g.node_id) || ':' || g.node_id || ':' || g.node_attempt || ':' || g.segment_sequence || ':' || g.model_turn) UNION ALL SELECT 'COUNTER root=' || b.root_run_id AS detail FROM alphafrog_agent_run_tree_budget b WHERE b.active_nodes != (SELECT count(*) FROM alphafrog_agent_run_tree_budget_operation o WHERE o.root_run_id = b.root_run_id AND o.kind = 'ACTIVE_NODE' AND o.state != 'RELEASED') OR b.external_waits != (SELECT count(*) FROM alphafrog_agent_run_tree_budget_operation o WHERE o.root_run_id = b.root_run_id AND o.kind = 'EXTERNAL_WAIT' AND o.state != 'RELEASED') ) anomalies LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run WHERE id = #{runId}) THEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run_work_item wi JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_tree_budget_operation o ON o.kind = 'ACTIVE_NODE' AND o.state != 'RELEASED' AND o.operation_id LIKE 'active-node:' || wi.id || ':%' WHERE wi.run_id = #{runId} ) ELSE NULL END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alphafrog_agent_run_tree_budget(root_run_id) VALUES (#{rootRunId}) ON CONFLICT (root_run_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT llm_calls, tool_calls, active_nodes, external_waits FROM alphafrog_agent_run_tree_budget WHERE root_run_id = #{rootRunId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT llm_calls, tool_calls, active_nodes, external_waits FROM alphafrog_agent_run_tree_budget WHERE root_run_id = #{rootRunId}
SELECT operation_id, root_run_id, kind, state FROM alphafrog_agent_run_tree_budget_operation WHERE operation_id = #{operationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_tree_budget SET llm_calls = llm_calls + CASE WHEN #{kind} = 'LLM_CALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tool_calls = tool_calls + CASE WHEN #{kind} = 'TOOL_CALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, active_nodes = active_nodes + CASE WHEN #{kind} = 'ACTIVE_NODE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, external_waits = external_waits + CASE WHEN #{kind} = 'EXTERNAL_WAIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE root_run_id = #{rootRunId} AND CASE #{kind} WHEN 'LLM_CALL' THEN llm_calls WHEN 'TOOL_CALL' THEN tool_calls WHEN 'ACTIVE_NODE' THEN active_nodes WHEN 'EXTERNAL_WAIT' THEN external_waits END < #{limit}

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_tree_budget SET llm_calls = llm_calls - CASE WHEN #{kind} = 'LLM_CALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tool_calls = tool_calls - CASE WHEN #{kind} = 'TOOL_CALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, active_nodes = active_nodes - CASE WHEN #{kind} = 'ACTIVE_NODE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, external_waits = external_waits - CASE WHEN #{kind} = 'EXTERNAL_WAIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE root_run_id = #{rootRunId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alphafrog_agent_run_tree_budget_operation(operation_id, root_run_id, kind, state) VALUES (#{operationId}, #{rootRunId}, #{kind}, 'RESERVED')
